name: RecoveryBoot
description: FreeInk boot-time recovery hatch and SD firmware flasher. Held at reset, a button combo (Back + Up by default) either flashes an update image straight from the SD card root (/update.bin) into the next OTA slot and reboots into it, or — with no update file present — repoints otadata at OTA slot 0 and reboots into the recovery / 'escape hatch' firmware. Call recovery::checkBootCombo() early in setup() of every firmware you want escapable/updatable. Includes a standalone flasher (firmware::flashFromSdPath) with full image validation (magic, chip_id, segment walk, XOR checksum, SHA256 trailer) and a self-contained otadata switch (no esp_image_verify, so it accepts patched Xteink images).
keywords: recovery, ota, bootloader, otadata, escape-hatch, sd-update, flasher, xteink
